signed_rows.behavior: The audit script runs hermes -z with the caller's provider, model and base URL, and the API key from the secret the caller names, through a config it writes into a fresh HOME; no vendor is named in the script.
signed_rows.fails_when: with a stub hermes, the recorded call lacks --provider P and -m MODEL from the environment, the config it saw lacks base_url or an api_key taken from the named env var, HOME is the runner's own, or the script contains anthropic, claude or openai outside comments

signed_rows.behavior: Every audit run passes -t kmctl_read, installs the kmctl-read Hermes plugin into the run's HOME and enables it, sets HERMES_WRITE_SAFE_ROOT to an empty folder, and runs hermes under timeout; the shipped workflow's audit step has timeout-minutes, and action.yml's mode help tells uses: callers to set it (a composite action's steps cannot take timeout-minutes).
signed_rows.fails_when: the stub hermes's arguments lack -t kmctl_read, the plugin files or plugins.enabled are missing from the run's HOME, HERMES_WRITE_SAFE_ROOT is unset or not an empty folder, hermes is not run under timeout, a stub hermes that sleeps past the limit is not stopped, the shipped workflow's audit step has no timeout-minutes, or action.yml's mode help does not tell callers to set timeout-minutes

signed_rows.behavior: The kmctl-read plugin registers one toolset, kmctl_read, holding only kmctl_read_file, kmctl_search_files and kmctl_list_files, written in plain Python with no shell; listing finds files by name inside the root; all three refuse any path that resolves outside the repository root, and a search pattern is only ever text to match.
signed_rows.fails_when: loading action/hermes/kmctl-read with a recording ctx registers any other tool or toolset; kmctl_list_files does not return a file inside the root whose path holds the given text, or returns any file for a folder outside the root; any of the three tools returns content or a count for a path outside the root, a symlink in the repo pointing out of it, the run's HOME, or /proc/self/environ; a pattern such as --pre=rm changes or creates any file; or the plugin source imports subprocess, os.system, pty or shlex; a pattern such as (a+)+$ on a line of 40 a's and a b takes more than a second; or a file symlink inside the repo pointing out of it is read by search

signed_rows.behavior: The prompt carries the audit skill, the needed review skills and the kmctl-auditor instructions as text, the filtered due list, and the repository's absolute path; findings still reach the summary and the issue body.
signed_rows.fails_when: the prompt hermes receives lacks any of those texts or the absolute path, or a findings block in the stub's plain stdout (with a footer after it) does not appear in the summary and the body under RUNNER_TEMP

signed_rows.behavior: The shipped audit workflow names every command as its own step, uses no uses: ./ for the audit, and takes provider, model, base URL and key secret as visible settings; action.yml has the same steps with provider, model, base_url and api_key_env inputs and no anthropic_api_key.
signed_rows.fails_when: .github/workflows/knowledge-audit.yml has a uses: ./ step, lacks a run step for kmctl, hermes installation, knowledge-audit.sh or knowledge-audit-issue.sh, or action.yml still has anthropic_api_key or lacks one of the four inputs

signed_rows.behavior: The token and event rules from ci-audit and ci-audit-hardening still hold.
signed_rows.fails_when: any other test in tests/test_ci_audit.py or tests/test_action.py fails

signed_rows.behavior: A new decision record says the audit does not tie a repository to one model vendor and replaces the Claude Code runner, and the bundle stays valid.
signed_rows.fails_when: .okf/decisions/ has no record naming Hermes and provider choice that links ADR 0005, or okf_validate --strict fails

signed_rows.behavior: A spike runs the real knowledge-audit.sh with real Hermes 0.19.0 against a fake OpenAI-compatible endpoint: only kmctl_read_file, kmctl_search_files and kmctl_list_files are offered, a requested write is refused, and the findings reach the summary.
signed_rows.fails_when: no audit-any-provider spike after the build records those three facts

resigns.reason: plan round 1 review: the plugin must refuse paths outside the repo root (a count search on /proc environ leaks the key), and the parser reads plain stdout
plan round 2 review: Hermes' search handler lets a pattern become an rg flag, so the plugin's tools are plain Python with no shell
plan round 3 review: regex search can hang past any in-process timeout, so search is plain text and hermes runs under a time limit
plan round 4 review: the auditor must list files by name, so the plugin gains kmctl_list_files under the same guard
r2: GitHub does not allow timeout-minutes on a composite action's step, so the shipped workflow sets it and action.yml's help tells callers to

overrides.reason: Round 3 found p3 (regex backtracking hangs the run); the revision matches plain text and runs hermes under timeout with timeout-minutes, so one more plan round checks it.
Round 4 found p4 (no way to list files by name, which list checks need); the revision adds kmctl_list_files under the same root guard, so one more plan round checks it.
